\section{WebCoder --- Security Guide}\label{webcoder--security-guide}

\begin{quote}
One-paragraph summary: WebCoder\textquotesingle s security posture rests
on five pillars --- an isolated judge sandbox reached only through a
filtering Docker socket proxy, httpOnly-cookie authentication with
rotation and CSRF, layered rate limits on every write path, a
moderation/reporting system with audit trails, and honest operational
security (backups, restore drills, published throttles, sandbox
receipts). This guide documents each control, where it lives in code,
and how to verify it.
\end{quote}

\textbf{Who it\textquotesingle s for:} operators, security reviewers,
teachers/parents asking "how is my student\textquotesingle s code run?".
Romanian twin:
\href{../guide-ro/SECURITATE.md}{\texttt{docs/guide-ro/SECURITATE.md}}.

\begin{center}\rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.5pt}\end{center}

\subsection{1. The judge sandbox (untrusted
code)}\label{1-the-judge-sandbox-untrusted-code}

Every judged execution runs inside the \texttt{judge-runner} container
with:

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \texttt{-\/-network\ none} --- no network during compilation or
  execution (verified in CI);
\item
  read-only submission mount (writable only through the orchestrated
  \texttt{/srv/judge} path);
\item
  all Linux capabilities dropped, \texttt{no-new-privileges}, uid 1000,
  memory/CPU/PID caps;
\item
  per-test wall+CPU time and max-RSS limits, persisted as receipts on
  every result row.
\end{itemize}

The worker reaches the daemon through \textbf{socket-proxy}
(tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy) granting only containers/exec POST
(+ping/version): \texttt{docker\ run\ hello-world} from the backend
answers 403; \texttt{docker\ exec\ webcoder-judge-runner\ id} succeeds.
Acceptance smoke in RUNBOOK §socket-proxy.

\textbf{Custom libraries} (python3 \texttt{custom\_libraries\_allowed}):
pip install runs in a one-shot container on an internal network whose
sole egress is a pre-seeded pypi allowlist proxy; requirement lines must
match \texttt{name} / \texttt{name==version} (git+/URLs/paths → 400 at
submit). Default posture fails closed.

\textbf{Sandbox receipts} --- \texttt{/sandbox-receipts} (user-facing):
every scratch/stress run\textquotesingle s limits and outcomes,
auditable.

\subsection{2. Authentication \&
sessions}\label{2-authentication--sessions}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  JWT access (5 min) + refresh (24 h) live in \textbf{httpOnly cookies}
  (\texttt{wc\_access}, \texttt{wc\_refresh}, SameSite=Lax dev /
  None+Secure cross-site); rotation blacklists the previous refresh;
  logout blacklists; nothing token-shaped touches \texttt{localStorage}.
\item
  Unsafe methods require the double-submit CSRF header
  (\texttt{GET\ /api/v1/auth/csrf/} issues the cookie).
\item
  Registration cannot self-assign roles (the B1 kill); role changes are
  admin-only.
\item
  2FA (TOTP) for privileged roles --- progressive enforcement via
  \texttt{TWO\_FACTOR\_ENFORCE}.
\item
  Personal API tokens for the read-only public API (revocable; higher
  throttle tier).
\item
  Password reset by single-use, email-aware tokens; OAuth providers
  scoped minimally (GitHub \texttt{user,user:email} in prod profile).
\end{itemize}

\subsection{3. Rate limiting (abuse \& DoS
surface)}\label{3-rate-limiting-abuse--dos-surface}

Redis-backed, shared across processes (\texttt{THROTTLE\_*} envs):

{\def\LTcaptype{none} % do not increment counter
\begin{longtable}[]{@{}ll@{}}
\toprule\noalign{}
Scope & Default \\
\midrule\noalign{}
\endhead
\bottomrule\noalign{}
\endlastfoot
anonymous baseline & 60/min \\
authenticated baseline & 240/min \\
auth (login/register) & 10/min \\
submission create & 20/hour \\
scratch / guest try-it / sample-run & own scoped caps (guest 5/h per
IP) \\
public API & 60/min (240/min with token) \\
translation proposals & 10/h \\
\end{longtable}
}

\subsection{4. Content \& community
safety}\label{4-content--community-safety}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  Report buttons on posts, messages, problems; moderator queue with SLA
  tracking and audit trail; appeals process.
\item
  Messaging: per-message reporting, RO+EN flag-not-block content filter,
  end-to-end blocks, send caps (30/h, 10 threads/h), minor-contact
  policy, report-gated transcripts.
\item
  Spoiler enforcement server-side inside problem-scoped threads;
  hide-at-threshold with reveal; trust-weighted voting.
\item
  Minors (GDPR Art. 8, Romania 16+): non-public profiles by default,
  county/school hidden, parental-consent recording, school-mediated
  enrollment.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{5. Data protection}\label{5-data-protection}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  GDPR: data export endpoint, soft-delete + scheduled purge, cookie
  notice, \texttt{/terms} + \texttt{/privacy} pages, DPA template for
  schools (\texttt{docs/DPA-TEMPLATE.md}).
\item
  Per-test outputs: hidden-test actual/expected outputs are stripped for
  non-privileged viewers; sample data is public by design; retention
  task blanks stale outputs after 90 days (verdicts/times always kept).
\item
  Backups: daily \texttt{pg\_dump\ -Fc} sidecar with 7d/4w/6m retention;
  off-host copy is an operator decision; restore + verify procedure with
  row-count acceptance.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{6. Operational security}\label{6-operational-security}

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  Secrets: compose fails loud (\texttt{\$\{SECRET\_KEY?err\}}); prod
  profile (\texttt{webcoder\_api.settings\_prod}) is deny-all until
  \texttt{ALLOWED\_HOSTS}/\texttt{CORS\_ALLOWED\_ORIGINS} are set; HSTS,
  secure cookies, SSL redirect, referrer policy, nosniff on.
\item
  Dependency posture: Dependabot + CodeQL + OSV scanner configs in-repo.
\item
  Observability: \texttt{/healthz} (liveness) + \texttt{/readyz}
  (db/cache/broker), JSON logs, admin metrics.
\item
  Incident contact: \texttt{/security} documents reporting; the
  bug-bounty page formalizes scope.
\end{itemize}

\subsection{7. How to verify the
claims}\label{7-how-to-verify-the-claims}

\begin{Shaded}
\begin{Highlighting}[]
\CommentTok{\# sandbox network isolation}
\ExtensionTok{docker}\NormalTok{ exec webcoder{-}judge{-}runner python }\AttributeTok{{-}c} \StringTok{"import urllib.request;urllib.request.urlopen(\textquotesingle{}http://p.org\textquotesingle{})"}   \CommentTok{\# must fail}

\CommentTok{\# socket{-}proxy denies container{-}create}
\ExtensionTok{docker}\NormalTok{ compose exec backend docker }\AttributeTok{{-}H}\NormalTok{ tcp://socket{-}proxy:2375 run }\AttributeTok{{-}{-}rm}\NormalTok{ hello{-}world   }\CommentTok{\# 403}

\CommentTok{\# judged submission still AC (load smoke with a real round{-}trip)}
\ExtensionTok{python}\NormalTok{ scripts/load\_smoke.py }\AttributeTok{{-}{-}base}\NormalTok{ http://127.0.0.1:8010 }\AttributeTok{{-}{-}judge}

\CommentTok{\# restore drill}
\ExtensionTok{scripts/restore{-}drill.sh}
\end{Highlighting}
\end{Shaded}
